verses.text: After Saul die, when David don return from di slaughter of di Amalekites, David stay two days for Ziklag.
On di third day, look, one man come out of di camp from Saul, im cloth don tear and dust dey im head. When e reach David, e fall to di earth and bow down.
David talk to am say, “Wia you come from?” E talk to am say, “I don escape from di camp of Israel.”
David talk to am say, “Wetin happen? I dey beg you, tell me.” E answer, “Di people don run from di battle, and plenty of di people don fall and die. Saul and im pikin man Jonathan don die too.”
David talk to di young man wey tell am say, “How you take know say Saul and im pikin man Jonathan don die?”
Di young man wey tell am talk say, “By chance I come reach Mount Gilboa, and look, Saul dey lean on im spear, and look, di chariots and di horsemen dey chase am hard.
When e look back, e see me, and e call me. I answer, ‘I dey here.’
E talk to me say, ‘Who you be?’ I answer am, ‘Na Amalekite I be.’
E talk to me say, ‘I dey beg you, stand over me and kill me, because pain don hold me, but my life still dey full inside me.’
So I stand over am and kill am, because I know say e no fit live after e don fall. I take di crown wey dey im head and di bracelet wey dey im arm, and I don bring dem here to my oga.”
Den David hold im cloth and tear am, and all di men wey dey with am do di same.
Dem mourn, weep and fast till evening for Saul and for im pikin man Jonathan, and for di people of di Lord, and for di house of Israel, because dem don fall by di sword.
David talk to di young man wey tell am say, “Wia you come from?” E answer, “Na pikin man of one foreigner, one Amalekite, I be.”
David talk to am say, “How come you no fear to stretch out your hand to kill di Lord anointed one?”
David call one of di young men, and talk say, “Go near, fall on am!” E strike am so tay e die.
David talk to am say, “Make your blood dey on your head, because your mouth don testify against you, talk say, ‘I don kill di Lord anointed one.’”
David sing dis lament over Saul and over im pikin man Jonathan,
and e command make dem teach di pikin dem of Judah di song of di Bow. Look, dem write am for di book of Jashar:
“Your glory, Israel, dem don kill am for your high places! How di mighty don fall!
No tell am for Gath, no announce am for di streets of Ashkelon, so that di pikin woman dem of di Philistines no go rejoice, so that di pikin woman dem of di uncircumcised no go celebrate.
You mountains of Gilboa, make dew or rain no dey on you, nor fields of offerings, because dere di shield of di mighty dirty, di shield of Saul, wey dem no anoint with oil.
From di blood of di slain, from di fat of di mighty, Jonathan bow no turn back, and Saul sword no return empty.
Saul and Jonathan dey lovely and pleasant for dem life, and for dem death dem no divide. Dem fast pass eagles, dem strong pass lions.
You pikin woman dem of Israel, weep over Saul, wey dress you with scarlet and joy, wey put ornaments of gold for your cloth.
How di mighty don fall for di middle of di battle! Dem don kill Jonathan for your high places.
I dey sorrow for you, my brother Jonathan. You dey very pleasant to me. Your love to me dey wonderful, e pass di love of women.
How di mighty don fall, and di weapons of war don perish!”
E happen say after dis, David ask di Lord, talk say, “I suppose go up to any of di cities of Judah?” Di Lord talk to am say, “Go up.” David talk say, “Wia I go go up?” E talk say, “To Hebron.”
So David go up dere, and im two wives too, Ahinoam di Jezreelitess and Abigail, di wife of Nabal di Carmelite.
David bring up im men wey dey with am, every man with im household, and dem live for di cities of Hebron.
Di men of Judah come, and dere dem anoint David king over di house of Judah. Dem tell David say, “Na di men of Jabesh Gilead bury Saul.”
David send messengers to di men of Jabesh Gilead, and talk to dem say, “Di Lord don bless una, because una show dis kindness to una oga, to Saul, and bury am.
Now make di Lord show una loving kindness and truth. I too go reward una for dis kindness, because una do dis thing.
So now make una hands strong, and be brave, because Saul una oga don die, and di house of Judah don anoint me king over dem.”
Abner di pikin of Ner, captain of Saul army, take Ish-bosheth di pikin of Saul and bring am cross go Mahanaim.
E make am king over Gilead, over di Ashurites, over Jezreel, over Ephraim, over Benjamin, and over all Israel.
Ish-bosheth, Saul pikin man, dey 40 years old when e begin to reign over Israel, and e reign two years. But di house of Judah follow David.
Di time wey David dey king for Hebron over di house of Judah na seven years and six months.
Abner di pikin of Ner and di servants of Ish-bosheth di pikin of Saul go out from Mahanaim go Gibeon.
Joab di pikin of Zeruiah and David servants go out and meet dem for di pool of Gibeon. Dem sit down, one group for one side of di pool, and di other group for di other side of di pool.
Abner talk to Joab say, “I dey beg you, make di young men rise and play before us.” Joab talk say, “Make dem rise.”
Den dem rise and cross over by number: 12 for Benjamin and for Ish-bosheth di pikin of Saul, and 12 of David servants.
Each one catch im opponent by di head and push im sword inside im friend side, so dem fall down together. So dem call dat place Helkath Hazzurim, wey dey Gibeon.
Di battle dey very hard dat day, and David servants beat Abner and di men of Israel.
Di three pikin man dem of Zeruiah dey dere: Joab, Abishai and Asahel. Asahel foot light like wild gazelle.
Asahel chase Abner, and as e dey go, e no turn to di right hand nor to di left from follow Abner.
Den Abner look back and talk say, “Na you be dat, Asahel?” E answer, “Na me.”
Abner talk to am say, “Turn go your right hand or your left, catch one of di young men, and take im armour.” But Asahel no gree turn aside from follow am.
Abner talk again to Asahel say, “Turn away from follow me. Why I go strike you to di ground? Den how I go fit raise my face before Joab your brother?”

But e refuse to turn aside. So Abner use di back end of im spear strike am for di belly, so tay di spear come out behind am. E fall down dere and die for di same place. Everybody wey come reach di place wia Asahel fall down and die, dem stand still.
But Joab and Abishai chase Abner. Sun don set when dem reach di hill of Ammah, wey dey before Giah, by di way of di wilderness of Gibeon.
Di pikin dem of Benjamin gather together behind Abner, become one band, and stand on top of one hill.
Den Abner call Joab, and talk say, “Di sword must dey devour forever? You no know say e go bitter for di end? Den how long before you tell di people make dem turn back from follow dem brothers?”
Joab talk say, “As God dey alive, if you no speak, surely den di people go don go away for morning, each one from follow im brother.”
So Joab blow trumpet, and all di people stand still. Dem no chase Israel again, and dem no fight again.
Abner and im men waka all dat night through di Arabah. Dem cross di Jordan, go through all Bithron, and reach Mahanaim.
Joab return from follow Abner. When e gather all di people together, 19 of David servants dey miss, plus Asahel.
But David servants don strike 360 men of Benjamin and of Abner men, and dem die.
Dem carry Asahel, bury am for im papa tomb wey dey Bethlehem. Joab and im men waka all night, and day break on dem for Hebron.
Now war dey long between di house of Saul and di house of David. David dey grow stronger and stronger, but di house of Saul dey grow weaker and weaker.
Dem born pikin man dem for David for Hebron. Im firstborn na Amnon, from Ahinoam di Jezreelitess.
Im second na Chileab, from Abigail di wife of Nabal di Carmelite. Di third na Absalom di pikin of Maacah, di pikin woman of Talmai king of Geshur.
Di fourth na Adonijah di pikin of Haggith. Di fifth na Shephatiah di pikin of Abital.
Di sixth na Ithream, from Eglah, David wife. Dem born dem for David for Hebron.
E happen say, as war dey between di house of Saul and di house of David, Abner make imself strong for di house of Saul.
Saul get one concubine wey im name na Rizpah, di pikin woman of Aiah. Ish-bosheth talk to Abner say, “Why you go in to my papa concubine?”

Den Abner angry plenty because of Ish-bosheth words, and talk say, “Na dog head I be wey belong to Judah? Dis day I dey show kindness to di house of Saul your papa, to im brothers and to im friends, and I no deliver you into David hand, yet today you dey accuse me of fault concerning dis woman!
God do so to Abner, and more also, if, as di Lord don swear to David, I no do so to am,
to take di kingdom from di house of Saul, and set up David throne over Israel and over Judah, from Dan reach Beersheba.”
E no fit answer Abner another word, because e fear am.
Abner send messengers to David for imself, talk say, “Na who di land belong to?” and e talk again, “Make your covenant with me, and look, my hand go dey with you, to bring all Israel come to you.”
E talk say, “Good, I go make covenant with you, but one thing I dey ask from you: you no go see my face, except you first bring Michal, Saul pikin woman, when you dey come see my face.”
David send messengers to Ish-bosheth, Saul pikin man, talk say, “Give me my wife Michal, wey I marry with 100 foreskins of di Philistines.”
Ish-bosheth send, and take Michal from im husband, from Paltiel di pikin of Laish.
Im husband go with am, e dey weep as e dey go, and e follow am reach Bahurim. Den Abner talk to am say, “Go, return!” E return.
Abner speak with di elders of Israel, talk say, “For time wey don pass, una dey look for David make e be king over una.
Now do am! Because di Lord don speak about David, talk say, ‘By di hand of my servant David, I go save my people Israel from di hand of di Philistines and from di hand of all dem enemies.’”
Abner speak too for di ears of Benjamin. Abner go too speak for David ears for Hebron all wetin good for Israel and for all di house of Benjamin.
So Abner come to David for Hebron, and 20 men dey with am. David make feast for Abner and di men wey dey with am.

Abner talk to David say, “I go rise go, and I go gather all Israel to my oga di king, so that dem go make covenant with you, and you go reign over all wetin your soul want.” David send Abner go, and e go in peace.
Look, David servants and Joab come back from raid, and bring plenty spoil with dem. But Abner no dey with David for Hebron, because David don send am go, and e don go in peace.
When Joab and all di army wey dey with am reach, dem tell Joab say, “Abner di pikin of Ner come to di king, and e don send am go, and e don go in peace.”
Den Joab come to di king, and talk say, “Wetin you do? Look, Abner come to you. Why you send am go, and e don go finish?
You know Abner di pikin of Ner, say e come to deceive you, and to know your going out and your coming in, and to know all wetin you dey do.”
When Joab go out from David, e send messengers after Abner, and dem bring am back from di well of Sirah, but David no know am.
When Abner return to Hebron, Joab take am aside to di middle of di gate to speak with am quietly, and e strike am dere for di belly, so tay e die, because of di blood of im brother Asahel.
After dat, when David hear am, e talk say, “I and my kingdom no get guilt before di Lord forever concerning di blood of Abner di pikin of Ner.

Make am fall on Joab head, and on all im papa house. Make anybody wey get discharge, or wey get leprosy, or wey dey lean on staff, or wey dey fall by sword, or wey lack bread, no fail from Joab house.”
So Joab and im brother Abishai kill Abner, because e kill dem brother Asahel for Gibeon for di battle.
David talk to Joab and to all di people wey dey with am say, “Tear una cloth, and wear sackcloth, and mourn before Abner.” King David follow di coffin.
Dem bury Abner for Hebron. Di king raise im voice and weep for Abner grave, and all di people weep.
Di king lament for Abner, and talk say, “Abner suppose die as fool dey die?
Dem no tie your hands, dem no put your feet inside chains. As man dey fall before wicked men, na so you fall.” All di people weep again over am.
All di people come make David eat bread while day still dey, but David swear, talk say, “God do so to me, and more also, if I taste bread or anything else until sun go down.”
All di people notice am, and e please dem, as everything wey di king do dey please all di people.
So all di people and all Israel understand dat day say e no come from di king to kill Abner di pikin of Ner.
Di king talk to im servants say, “You no know say one prince and one great man don fall dis day for Israel?
I dey weak today, though dem don anoint me king, and dis men, Zeruiah pikin man dem, too hard for me. Make di Lord reward di evildoer according to im wickedness.”
When Saul pikin man hear say Abner don die for Hebron, im hands weak, and all Israel dey troubled.

Saul pikin man get two men wey be captains of bands. Di name of one na Baanah, and di name of di other na Rechab, Rimmon pikin man dem, di Beerothite, of di pikin dem of Benjamin. Beeroth too dem count am as part of Benjamin.
Di Beerothites run go Gittaim, and dem don dey live dere as foreigners until dis day.

Now Jonathan, Saul pikin man, get one pikin man wey lame for im feet. E dey five years old when di news about Saul and Jonathan come from Jezreel, and im nurse carry am run. As di nurse dey hurry to run, di boy fall, and e become lame. Im name na Mephibosheth.
Rimmon di Beerothite pikin man dem, Rechab and Baanah, go, and come reach Ish-bosheth house for di heat of di day, as e dey rest for afternoon.
Dem come inside di middle of di house as if dem wan carry wheat, and dem strike am for di belly. Rechab and im brother Baanah escape.
When dem enter di house, as e dey lie down on im bed for im bedroom, dem strike am, kill am, cut off im head, take im head, and waka by di way of di Arabah all night.

Dem bring Ish-bosheth head to David for Hebron, and talk to di king say, “Look, di head of Ish-bosheth di pikin of Saul, your enemy, wey dey look for your life! Dis day di Lord don avenge my oga di king on Saul and im seed.”
David answer Rechab and im brother Baanah, Rimmon di Beerothite pikin man dem, and talk to dem say, “As di Lord dey alive, wey don redeem my soul from all trouble,
when somebody tell me say, ‘Look, Saul don die,’ and e think say e bring good news, I catch am and kill am for Ziklag. Dat na di reward wey I give am for im news.
E go worse pass dat, when wicked men kill one righteous person for im own house on im bed. I no go now demand im blood from your hand, and wipe you out from di earth?”
David command im young men, and dem kill dem, cut off dem hands and dem feet, and hang dem beside di pool for Hebron. But dem take Ish-bosheth head and bury am for Abner grave for Hebron.
Den all di tribes of Israel come to David for Hebron, and talk say, “Look, we na your bone and your flesh.

For time wey don pass, when Saul dey king over us, na you dey lead Israel go out and bring dem come in. Di Lord talk to you say, ‘You go be shepherd of my people Israel, and you go be prince over Israel.’”
So all di elders of Israel come to di king for Hebron, and King David make covenant with dem for Hebron before di Lord. Den dem anoint David king over Israel.
David dey 30 years old when e begin to reign, and e reign 40 years.
For Hebron e reign over Judah seven years and six months, and for Jerusalem e reign 33 years over all Israel and Judah.

Di king and im men go Jerusalem against di Jebusites, wey dey live for di land. Dem speak to David, talk say, “Except you take away di blind and di lame, you no go enter here,” because dem think say, “David no fit enter here.”
But David take di stronghold of Zion, wey na David city.

David talk dat day say, “Anybody wey wan strike di Jebusites, make e go up through di water tunnel, and strike di lame and di blind, wey David soul hate.” So dem dey talk say, “Di blind and di lame dey dere, e no fit enter di house.”
David live for di stronghold and call am David city. David build round am from Millo go inside.
David dey grow greater and greater, because di Lord God of Armies dey with am.
Hiram king of Tyre send messengers to David, with cedar trees, carpenters and masons, and dem build house for David.
David know say di Lord don establish am king over Israel, and say e don lift up im kingdom for im people Israel sake.
David take more concubines and wives from Jerusalem after e don come from Hebron, and dem born more pikin man dem and pikin woman dem for David.
Dis na di names of dem wey dem born for am for Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,
Elishama, Eliada and Eliphelet.
When di Philistines hear say dem don anoint David king over Israel, all di Philistines go up to look for David. David hear am and go down to di stronghold.
Now di Philistines don come, and dem spread demselves for di valley of Rephaim.
David ask di Lord, talk say, “I go go up against di Philistines? You go deliver dem into my hand?” Di Lord talk to David say, “Go up, because I go surely deliver di Philistines into your hand.”
David come to Baal Perazim, and David strike dem dere. E talk say, “Di Lord don break my enemies before me like water wey break through.” So e call dat place Baal Perazim.
Dem leave dem idols dere, and David and im men carry dem go.
Di Philistines come up again, and dem spread demselves for di valley of Rephaim.
When David ask di Lord, e talk say, “You no go go up. Go round behind dem, and come attack dem from di opposite side of di mulberry trees.
E go be say, when you hear di sound of marching for di top of di mulberry trees, den you go move quick, because dat time di Lord don go out before you to strike di army of di Philistines.”
David do so as di Lord command am, and e strike di Philistines from Geba reach Gezer.
David gather again all di chosen men of Israel, 30,000.
David rise and go with all di people wey dey with am from Baale Judah, to bring up from dere di ark of God, wey dem dey call by di Name, di name of di Lord of Armies wey sit above di cherubim.
Dem put di ark of God on one new cart and bring am out of Abinadab house wey dey di hill. Uzzah and Ahio, Abinadab pikin man dem, dey drive di new cart.
Dem bring am out of Abinadab house wey dey di hill, with di ark of God, and Ahio dey waka before di ark.

David and all di house of Israel dey play before di Lord with all kinds of instruments wey dem make from cypress wood, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with castanets and with cymbals.
When dem reach Nacon threshing floor, Uzzah stretch out im hand to di ark of God and hold am, because di oxen stumble.
Di Lord anger burn against Uzzah, and God strike am dere for im error, and e die dere by di ark of God.
David dey angry because di Lord don break out against Uzzah, and e call dat place Perez Uzzah, till dis day.
David fear di Lord dat day, and e talk say, “How di ark of di Lord go fit come to me?”
So David no gree move di ark of di Lord to dey with am for David city, but David carry am go put for Obed-Edom di Gittite house.
Di ark of di Lord stay for Obed-Edom di Gittite house three months, and di Lord bless Obed-Edom and all im household.
Dem tell King David say, “Di Lord don bless Obed-Edom house and everything wey belong to am because of di ark of God.” David go bring up di ark of God from Obed-Edom house go David city with joy.
E happen say, when dem wey carry di ark of di Lord don waka six paces, e sacrifice one ox and one fat calf.
David dance before di Lord with all im strength, and David wear linen ephod.
So David and all di house of Israel bring up di ark of di Lord with shouting and with di sound of trumpet.
E happen say, as di ark of di Lord dey enter David city, Michal, Saul pikin woman, look through di window, and see King David dey jump and dance before di Lord, and Michal despise am for im heart.
Dem bring in di ark of di Lord and put am for im place, inside di tent wey David pitch for am. David offer burnt offerings and peace offerings before di Lord.
When David finish to offer di burnt offering and di peace offerings, e bless di people for di name of di Lord of Armies.
E share to all di people, to all di multitude of Israel, both men and women, to everybody one cake of bread, one portion of meat and one cake of raisins. Den all di people go, everybody go im house.

Den David return to bless im household. Michal, Saul pikin woman, come out to meet David, and talk say, “How glorious di king of Israel dey today, wey uncover imself today before di eyes of di maids of im servants, as one of di foolish men dey uncover imself without shame!”
David talk to Michal say, “Na before di Lord, wey choose me pass your papa and pass all im house, to appoint me prince over di people of di Lord, over Israel. So I go celebrate before di Lord.
I go still dey more low pass dis, and I go dey humble for my own eyes. But di maids wey you talk about, dem go honour me.”
Michal, Saul pikin woman, no get pikin until di day of im death.
E happen say, when di king dey live for im house, and di Lord don give am rest from all im enemies round about,
di king talk to Nathan di prophet say, “See now, I dey dwell for house of cedar, but di ark of God dey dwell inside curtains.”
Nathan talk to di king say, “Go, do all wetin dey your heart, because di Lord dey with you.”
E happen say dat night, di word of di Lord come to Nathan, talk say,
“Go tell my servant David, ‘Dis na wetin di Lord talk: You na di one wey go build house for me to dwell inside?
Because I never live for house since di day wey I bring up di pikin dem of Israel out of Egypt until today, but I dey move about for tent and for tabernacle.

For all di places wia I waka with all di pikin dem of Israel, I ever speak one word to any of di judges of Israel, wey I command to shepherd my people Israel, talk say, “Why una no build house of cedar for me?”’
Now so you go tell my servant David dis, ‘Dis na wetin di Lord of Armies talk: I take you from di sheep pen, from follow di sheep, to be prince over my people, over Israel.
I don dey with you wherever you go, and I don cut off all your enemies from before you. I go make big name for you, like di name of di great ones for di earth.
I go appoint place for my people Israel, and I go plant dem so that dem go dwell for dem own place and nobody go move dem again. Di pikin dem of wickedness no go afflict dem again as before,
and as from di day wey I command judges to dey over my people Israel. I go make you rest from all your enemies. Moreover di Lord dey tell you say di Lord go make house for you.
When your days complete and you sleep with your papa dem, I go set up your seed after you, wey go come out of your body, and I go establish im kingdom.
Na im go build house for my name, and I go establish di throne of im kingdom forever.
I go be im papa, and e go be my pikin man. If e do iniquity, I go discipline am with di rod of men and with di stripes of di pikin dem of men,
but my loving kindness no go leave am, as I take am from Saul, wey I put away before you.
Your house and your kingdom go dey sure forever before you. Your throne go dey established forever.’”
According to all dem words and according to all dis vision, na so Nathan speak to David.
Den King David go in, sit before di Lord, and talk say, “Who I be, di Lord God, and wetin my house be, so tay you don bring me reach here?
Dis still small for your eyes, di Lord God, but you don speak too about your servant house for long time to come, and dis na according to di manner of men, di Lord God!
Wetin more David fit talk to you? Because you know your servant, di Lord God.
For your word sake, and according to your own heart, you don do all dis greatness to make your servant know am.
So you great, di Lord God, because nobody like you, and no God dey except you, according to all wey we don hear with our ears.

Wetin nation for di earth dey like your people, like Israel, wey God go redeem for imself to be im people, and to make name for imself, and to do great and awesome things for dem, as e drive out nations and dem gods from before im people wey you redeem for yourself from Egypt?
You establish your people Israel for yourself to be your people forever, and you, di Lord, become dem God.
Now, di Lord God, di word wey you don speak about your servant and about im house, confirm am forever, and do as you don speak.
Make your name dey magnified forever, make dem talk say, ‘Di Lord of Armies na God over Israel,’ and make di house of your servant David dey established before you.
Because you, di Lord of Armies, di God of Israel, don reveal to your servant, talk say, ‘I go build house for you.’ So your servant find for im heart to pray dis prayer to you.
Now, di Lord God, you na God, and your words na truth, and you don promise dis good thing to your servant.

Now make e please you to bless di house of your servant, so that e go continue forever before you, because you, di Lord God, don speak am. Make di house of your servant dey blessed forever with your blessing.”
After dis, David strike di Philistines and subdue dem, and David take Metheg Ammah from di hand of di Philistines.

E strike Moab and measure dem with line, as e make dem lie down for di ground. E measure two lines to put to death and one full line to keep alive. Di Moabites become David servants and dem bring tribute.
David strike Hadadezer di pikin of Rehob, king of Zobah, too, as e dey go to restore im dominion for di River.
David take from am 1,700 horsemen and 20,000 footmen. David cut di leg tendons of all di chariot horses, but e keep enough for 100 chariots.
When di Syrians of Damascus come help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David strike 22,000 men of di Syrians.
Den David put garrisons for Syria of Damascus, and di Syrians become David servants and bring tribute. Di Lord give David victory wherever e go.
David take di shields of gold wey dey Hadadezer servants and bring dem go Jerusalem.
From Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David take plenty bronze.
When Toi king of Hamath hear say David don strike all Hadadezer army,

den Toi send im pikin man Joram to King David to greet am and bless am because e don fight against Hadadezer and strike am, because Hadadezer dey fight wars with Toi. Joram bring with am vessels of silver, vessels of gold and vessels of bronze.
King David dedicate dem too to di Lord, with di silver and gold wey e dedicate from all di nations wey e subdue,
from Syria, from Moab, from di pikin dem of Ammon, from di Philistines, from Amalek, and from di spoil of Hadadezer di pikin of Rehob, king of Zobah.
David make name for imself when e return from striking di Syrians for di Valley of Salt, 18,000 men.
E put garrisons for Edom. E put garrisons throughout all Edom, and all di Edomites become David servants. Di Lord give David victory wherever e go.
David reign over all Israel, and David do justice and righteousness to all im people.
Joab di pikin of Zeruiah dey over di army, and Jehoshaphat di pikin of Ahilud na di recorder.
Zadok di pikin of Ahitub and Ahimelech di pikin of Abiathar na priests, and Seraiah na scribe.
Benaiah di pikin of Jehoiada dey over di Cherethites and di Pelethites, and David pikin man dem na chief ministers.
David talk say, “Anybody still dey wey remain for Saul house, so that I fit show am kindness for Jonathan sake?”
Servant dey for Saul house wey im name na Ziba, and dem call am to David. Di king talk to am say, “Na you be Ziba?” E talk say, “I na your servant.”
Di king talk say, “Nobody still dey of Saul house, so that I fit show am God kindness?” Ziba talk to di king say, “Jonathan still get one pikin man wey lame for im feet.”
Di king talk to am say, “Wia e dey?” Ziba talk to di king say, “Look, e dey Machir di pikin of Ammiel house for Lo Debar.”
Den King David send, and bring am out of Machir di pikin of Ammiel house for Lo Debar.
Mephibosheth, di pikin of Jonathan, di pikin of Saul, come to David, fall on im face and bow down. David talk say, “Mephibosheth?” E answer, “Look, your servant!”
David talk to am say, “No fear, because I go surely show you kindness for Jonathan your papa sake, and I go restore to you all di land of Saul your papa, and you go eat bread for my table always.”
E bow down and talk say, “Wetin your servant be, wey you go look dead dog like me?”
Den di king call Ziba, Saul servant, and talk to am say, “All wetin belong to Saul and to all im house, I don give to your oga pikin man.

You, your pikin man dem and your servants go till di land for am, and bring in di fruits, so that your oga pikin man go get bread to eat. But Mephibosheth your oga pikin man go eat bread always for my table.” Ziba get 15 pikin man dem and 20 servants.

Den Ziba talk to di king say, “According to all wetin my oga di king command im servant, na so your servant go do.” Di king talk say, “As for Mephibosheth, e go eat for my table like one of di king pikin man dem.”
Mephibosheth get one young pikin man wey im name na Mica. All wey dey live for Ziba house na Mephibosheth servants.
So Mephibosheth live for Jerusalem, because e dey eat always for di king table, and e lame for both im feet.
E happen say after dis, di king of di pikin dem of Ammon die, and im pikin man Hanun reign for im place.

David talk say, “I go show kindness to Hanun di pikin of Nahash, as im papa show kindness to me.” So David send im servants to comfort am concerning im papa. David servants come into di land of di pikin dem of Ammon.

But di princes of di pikin dem of Ammon talk to Hanun dem oga say, “You think say David dey honour your papa, so e send comforters to you? David no send im servants to you to explore di city, to spy am out, and to overthrow am?”
So Hanun take David servants, shave off half of dem beards, cut dem garments for di middle reach dem buttocks, and send dem go.
When dem tell David, e send to meet dem, because di men shame well well. Di king talk say, “Wait for Jericho until una beards grow, den return.”

When di pikin dem of Ammon see say dem don become hated by David, di pikin dem of Ammon send hire di Syrians of Beth Rehob and di Syrians of Zobah, 20,000 footmen, and di king of Maacah with 1,000 men, and di men of Tob 12,000 men.
When David hear am, e send Joab and all di army of di mighty men.
Di pikin dem of Ammon come out and arrange battle for di entrance of di gate, and di Syrians of Zobah and Rehob, and di men of Tob and Maacah, dey by demselves for di field.
When Joab see say dem don set di battle against am from front and from back, e choose some of di choice men of Israel and arrange dem against di Syrians.
Di rest of di people e put for di hand of im brother Abishai, and e arrange dem against di pikin dem of Ammon.
E talk say, “If di Syrians too strong for me, den you go help me, but if di pikin dem of Ammon too strong for you, den I go come help you.
Be brave, and make we be strong for our people and for di cities of our God. Make di Lord do wetin good for im eyes.”
So Joab and di people wey dey with am draw near for di battle against di Syrians, and dem run before am.
When di pikin dem of Ammon see say di Syrians don run, dem too run before Abishai and enter di city. Den Joab return from di pikin dem of Ammon and come Jerusalem.
When di Syrians see say Israel don defeat dem, dem gather demselves together.
Hadadezer send and bring out di Syrians wey dey beyond di River, and dem come Helam, with Shobach di captain of Hadadezer army for dem front.
Dem tell David, and e gather all Israel together, cross di Jordan and come Helam. Di Syrians arrange demselves against David and fight with am.
Di Syrians run before Israel, and David kill di men of 700 chariots and 40,000 horsemen of di Syrians, and e strike Shobach di captain of dem army so tay e die dere.
When all di kings wey be Hadadezer servants see say Israel don defeat dem, dem make peace with Israel and serve dem. So di Syrians fear to help di pikin dem of Ammon again.
